flow.notes: TRIGGER — Fires when a deal moves to 'Closed Won' in the Talent Bookings pipeline (i.e., the client has confirmed and paid).

mapper.subject: Booking Confirmed! — {{1.talentType}} for {{1.eventDate}}
mapper.htmlBody:
Hi {{1.contactName}},

Your booking is officially confirmed! Here's a summary:

Talent{{1.talentType}}
Event Date{{1.eventDate}}
Venue{{1.eventVenue}}
Amount${{1.amount}}

We'll be in touch closer to the event date with logistics details. If you have any questions, just reply to this email.

Thank you for choosing [Your Agency]!

flow.notes: BOOKING CONFIRMATION — Sends the client a final confirmation email with a summary of their booked talent, date, venue, and price.

mapper.subject: New Booking Assignment — {{1.eventDate}} at {{1.eventVenue}}
mapper.htmlBody:
Hi,

You've been booked for an upcoming event. Here are the details:

  • Client: {{1.contactName}}
  • Event Date: {{1.eventDate}}
  • Venue: {{1.eventVenue}}
  • Deal: {{1.dealName}}

Please confirm your availability by replying to this email within 24 hours.

Thanks,
[Your Agency]

flow.notes: TALENT NOTIFICATION — Emails the booked talent with event details so they can confirm availability and prepare.
LOG BOOKING — Adds the confirmed booking to a 'Confirmed Bookings' sheet for operations tracking and reporting.
EVENT CALENDAR — Creates an all-day event on the bookings calendar so the team sees the confirmed gig at a glance.
TEAM ALERT — Posts a celebration message in the #bookings Slack channel so the whole team knows about the new deal.

scenario.name: Scenario 3: Post-Booking Deal Management
scenario.description: When a deal is marked Closed Won in CRM, sends confirmations to client and talent, logs the booking, creates a calendar event, and alerts the team.
